_comment: Complete inventory of the installed toolchain, scanned from disk.
Binaries are NOT vendored: sizes, licenses, and GitHub's 100 MB
per-file limit make it impossible, and repackaging a vendor's
distributed binary is not sharing. What is vendored is this
contract: every tool, version, source, license, installer script,
and the skills that depend on it.

tools.name: Cpp2IL
tools.role: Alternative IL2CPP to managed-code converter.

tools.name: Il2CppDumper
tools.role: Unity IL2CPP metadata and symbol dumping.

tools.name: ReClass.NET
tools.role: Class and struct reconstruction GUI.

tools.name: SysinternalsSuite
tools.role: 164 executables: process, driver, and system inspection.

tools.name: TitanHide
tools.role: Windows kernel driver that hides a debugger from user-mode tools. x64dbg plugins included. 31 files, 7 binaries.
tools.source: PROVENANCE NOT RECORDED - the folder on this machine has no .git and no README. Obtain the source yourself; do not trust an unattributed driver of this kind.
tools.license: NO LICENSE FILE seen on disk - verify before use
tools.installer: manual - not installed by any script here
tools.vendoring: NOT VENDORABLE - offensive kernel tooling, unattributed

tools.name: capa
tools.role: Capability mapping with ATT&CK IDs. Run FIRST on any unfamiliar binary.

tools.name: cheat-mcp
tools.role: 72-tool MCP: process/module enum, memory read/write/scan, pointer chains, DLL injection, IAT hooking, anti-cheat detection, network capture.
tools.license: NO LICENSE FILE present in the repository as cloned - verify before use
tools.vendoring: NOT VENDORABLE - third-party source plus a local patch
tools.local_patch: src/network.cpp line 15 adds #include <mstcpip.h>. Upstream omits it, which breaks the SIO_RCVALL call at line 246; the file carries a comment saying so. LOCAL FIX - conflicts on a fresh git pull.

tools.name: de4dot
tools.role: .NET deobfuscator and IL post-processor.

tools.name: die
tools.role: Detect It Easy: packer and protector identification.

tools.name: dnSpy
tools.role: .NET decompiler. dnSpy.Console for headless use.

tools.name: ffuf
tools.role: Fuzzing and content discovery.

tools.name: ghidra-mcp
tools.role: MCP server wrapping Ghidra. REJECTED as a duplicate: REA already supplies 170 tools including a Ghidra provider, and the extension name collides with the local fork. 6.0.0 present on disk.
tools.license: check upstream before use - no LICENSE file seen on disk

tools.name: gobuster
